what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from the United States in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3779 American asylum seekers, and Canada hosted 74.6% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are the United Kingdom, Mexico and Ireland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of the United States of America with al-Qaida from 2001 to 2017 and in 2019.
The fact pack does not link that conflict to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 86 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2020 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
